Senses.Explanation: The “ancestral vehicle from before” (從上宗乘) names the lineage vehicle handed down from earlier generations; in its recurring public case it is what Pang Yun asks Baizhang Huaihai to point out. Several independent lamp compilations preserve Pang Yun’s question, “How is the ancestral vehicle from before pointed out?” (從上宗乘如何指來), followed by Baizhang Huaihai’s silence and Pang Yun’s objection that later people must not be cut off. Other addresses ask how this inherited lineage business is displayed or carried; the vehicle is not a literal cart.
